TutoExplainContent: Welcome into the ConnectTheDots activity. ConnectTheDots is a fun activity where you can draw lines between dots, connect numbered dots in order, or play a multiplayer territory game
TutoNetworkContent: Click here to share the activity with other users on the network
TutoModeButtonContent: Click here to switch between Draw mode, Number mode and Game mode. Each mode has its own set of tools and rules
TutoDrawModeContent: In Draw mode, you can freely draw lines between dots on the canvas. Use the drawing tools to create shapes and connect dots however you like
TutoDrawCanvasContent: This is your drawing board. Click and drag between dots to draw lines connecting them. The dots will react when your cursor is near them
TutoDrawButtonContent: Click here to select the draw tool to connect dots
TutoEraseButtonContent: Click here to select the eraser tool to remove lines you have drawn
TutoClearButtonContent: Click here to clear all the lines on the board and start over
TutoColorButtonContent: Click here to change the drawing color
TutoNumberModeContent: In Number mode, you need to connect numbered dots in the correct order to complete figures. Choose a figure from the library and click the dots in numerical order (1, 2, 3...) to reveal the shape
TutoNumberCanvasContent: This is your playing board. Click on the numbered dots in order starting from 1. When you click the correct dot, a line will be drawn to it automatically
TutoLibraryButtonContent: Click here to open the library and choose a figure to play. Figures are organized into categories like Basic Shapes, Objects and Numbers
TutoTimerButtonContent: Click here to set a timer for the challenge. You can choose between no timer, 1 minute, 2 minutes or 5 minutes
TutoEditorContent: Welcome to the figure editor. Here you can create your own custom figures by adding dots
TutoEditorCanvasContent: Click anywhere on the board to add a new dot. The dots will be connected in the order you create them
TutoRemoveDotContent: Click here to undo and remove the last dot you added
TutoGoBackContent: Click here to return to the previous screen
TutoSettingViewContent: In this view you can create new custom categories and figures, and edit your existing ones
TutoSettingGalleryContent: Click on the '+' button inside any category to create a new figure. You can also click on your existing custom figures to edit them
TutoPlayGalleryContent: Click on any figure to start playing it
TutoNewCategoryContent: Click here to create a new custom category for your figures
TutoNewFigureContent: Click here to add a new figure to this category
TutoEditFigureContent: Click here to edit this custom figure
TutoDeleteFigureContent: Click here to permanently delete this figure
TutoEditCategoryContent: Click here to edit this category
TutoDeleteCategoryContent: Click here to permanently delete this category
TutoViewButtonContent: Click here to toggle between Play view and Settings view
